lines.say: A little boy left his stuffed giraffe at a Ritz-Carlton.
The hotel could've just mailed it back.
They sent photos of the giraffe at the pool, at the spa, with the resort's parrot.
caps: Photos of the giraffe *at the pool,*

lines.say: That was years ago, and people still tell that story.
Your version is small. Text the fresh cut, and add one line about his week.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
